headline.title: Pre-season: cold nights ahead.
headline.text: 17 of the 19 resorts close to opening get nights cold enough to make snow, mostly in White Mountains and Northern Vermont. Killington typically opens first, around Nov 8.

snowshoe.headline: Freeze Warning issued October 17 at 3:04PM EDT until October 18 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Charleston WV
snowshoe.text: * WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 28 expected. * WHERE...Portions of northeast Kentucky, southeast Ohio, southwest Virginia, and central, northeast, northern, southeast, southern, and western West Virginia. * WHEN...From 1 AM to 9 AM EDT Sunday. * IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor plumbing.

camelback.headline: Freeze Warning issued October 17 at 12:59PM EDT until October 18 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Mount Holly NJ
camelback.text: * WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 28 expected. * WHERE...In New Jersey, Sussex County. In Pennsylvania, Carbon and Monroe Counties. * WHEN...From 1 AM to 9 AM EDT Sunday. * IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor plumbing.

sevensprings.headline: Freeze Warning issued October 17 at 12:36PM EDT until October 18 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS State College PA
sevensprings.text: * WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures between 25 and 30 expected. * WHERE...Most of central Pennsylvania. * WHEN...From 1 AM to 9 AM EDT Sunday. * IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor plumbing. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Valley locations and sheltered rural areas will experience the coldest temperatures.

BTV.excerpt:
A chilly overnight period tonight will be followed by quiet and dry weather well into mid week.
High probability of dry weather and seasonable temperatures continuing through next weekend.

ALY.excerpt: ) Below normal temperatures will continue overnight into Sunday with decreasing winds.

GYX.excerpt: Dry conditions look to persist from Sunday through much of next week as high pressure dominates over the Northeast. High temperatures will be fairly typical for mid October with overnight lows running below normal.

BUF.excerpt:
) A freeze this morning, then areas of frost tonight.
) An extended period of dry and warmer weather begins this afternoon and likely lasts through the week.

PHI.excerpt:
A cold airmass builds into the region this weekend. Freeze Warnings are in effect for tonight. Another round of frost is possible Sunday night into Monday morning.
Uncertainty persists regarding a nor'easter developing off the coast of the southern Mid-Atlantic that may cause unsettled conditions and hazardous marine impacts early next week.

CTP.excerpt:
) Frost/Freeze late tonight into early Sunday morning
) Extended stretch of dry weather next week

RLX.excerpt:
) Widespread freeze expected tonight into early Sunday morning.
) Next week will be seasonable and quiet.

writeups.name: Vermont
writeups.title: Dry, with cold nights.
paras: Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:20}} to {{t:54}}, mostly dry.
Killington usually opens first here, around Nov 8. Jay Peak gets the most hours cold enough to make snow this week (about 28).
NWS Burlington forecasters, Saturday 7:28 PM: "A chilly overnight period tonight will be followed by quiet and dry weather well into mid week."
writeups.outlook: Days 8 to 14: NOAA's outlook leans slightly warmer than normal and slightly drier than normal.
